method: Independent observation of rebuilt randomized blind-sheet.png and deterministic enlarged copies, without answer key or labeled directions.

pairs.reason: A raised face points slightly right: nose and eye center shift right under the horns. B raised face projects left, exposing the left-facing cheek profile.
A nose and visible eye turn screen-right; B nose and visible eye turn screen-left with hair mass behind the opposite cheek.
A nearly profiled head clearly points right at nose tip; B head profile points left. Torso remains frontal in both.
A level face and nose point right; B level face and nose point left, both with distinct directional eye placement.
A lowered nose and gaze point left; B lowered nose and gaze point right, visible as opposite cheek openings beneath white bangs.
A bowed head retains a rightward nose/eye offset; B bowed head retains a leftward nose/eye offset.
A strongly lowered face remains slightly right of neck center; B lowered face and nose remain left of neck center.
A chin lifted high and eye line aimed above with neck exposed; B chin tucked, crown and bangs more prominent and eyes looking below.
A face lifted and nose tilts upward; B face lowered and chin angled down toward neckline.
A chin below the face-neutral level and upper bangs prominent; B nose and chin raised with gaze above.
A rightward nose/eye line has slight upward pitch; B same rightward profile inclines downward, chin closer to collar.
A leftward face raises chin with gaze toward above; B leftward face bows with chin toward neckline.
A face tilts back and nose points up; B forehead leads forward and chin drops below eye line.
A left-facing eye/nose line is slightly below horizontal and chin lowered; B left-facing face lifts its nose and chin, leaving more neck visible.
